<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 127.0997, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈126.092 Da. The isotopic pattern (M+1 ≈8 % of M) matches a molecule containing about eight carbons. The formula C₈H₁₄O has a calculated monoisotopic mass of 126.1045 Da, which is within the experimental tolerance and fits the observed isotopic distribution and DBE (2). Therefore, the molecular formula is C₈H₁₄O.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H14O</final_answer>
